post.summary: Grant D-Sports Direct Rep to a user
post.description: isAdmin only. Body: { amount: integer 1–100000, reason?: string max 200, idempotencyKey?: string }. Retries: send an Idempotency-Key header (or body idempotencyKey; the header wins), 1–128 of letters, digits, '_', '-', ':' or '.'. The ledger keys the grant per admin, so a retry returns the original entry with alreadyRecorded: true and grants nothing new; reusing a key with a different amount is 409 IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED. Without a key each POST is a new grant.

post.description: Platform moderator/admin only (#998). Upsert semantics: creates the slug when absent and saves the draft block, or re-saves the draft of an existing slug. get.summary: List a team's packs with contents (admin; pack-test source)
get.description: Requires canAccessTeam: platform admin/superadmin, or any TeamAdmin role on the team (owner, editor, viewer). `teamId` is a team id or slug. Always includes contents (`includeContents: true`) with the full collectible, plus `maxReveal`, so web PackTesting and native (engage-native#1248) can run weightedRandomSelect(pack.contents, pack.maxReveal) locally. There is no pack-test start/stop session API: simulated opens are never sent to or stored by the server. Newest first, no pagination. `archived=true` lists archived packs only (status archived, ordered by updatedAt desc) with the same contents shape. Staging JSON capture is deferred; the example is a fixture, not a live capture.

post.summary: Mint a signed upload URL for a pack-opening template GLB
post.description: Team templates (canManageTeam) land at teams/{teamId}/templates/. Global templates require scope "global" and an admin, and land at templates/. Omitting teamId without scope global is rejected. The file never passes through this route: PUT it to signedUrl, then POST /api/admin/packs/confirm-upload with kind "glb-template" before persisting modelUrl and glbTemplateVersion. Validation: .glb, MIME model/gltf-binary or application/octet-stream, 1 byte–10MB, magicBytes start with glTF. Header, material slots, and extensions are checked on confirm.

post.summary: Mint a signed upload URL for pack or card-case art
post.description: Team managers only (canManageTeam). Staging key teams/{teamId}/pack-art/{front|back|card-case|card-back}/staging/. Confirm with the same kind. Pack front/back require glbTemplateVersion 0 or 2: version 0 contains the image in the UV window on a 1024x1536 canvas, and version 2 fills a 1104x1536 canvas. Card-case and card-back ignore glbTemplateVersion; confirm covers a 1200x1680 canvas. The stored object is immutable.

glbTemplateVersion.description: Required for pack-art-front and pack-art-back. 0 selects the UV window on a 1024x1536 canvas. 2 selects the full-bleed 1104x1536 canvas. Omitted or any other integer is rejected for those kinds. card-case-art and card-back ignore this property.

200.description: { signedUrl, token, path, publicUrl, bucket, contentType }

post.summary: Confirm a signed pack / collectible asset upload
post.description: Team managers only, except a global template at templates/ which requires an admin. Revalidates the stored object: path prefix, size equals expectedSize, and magic. kind glb-template downloads the object (max 10MB), rejects text/html, Draco, and KTX2, accepts EXT_meshopt_compression, and returns glbTemplateVersion, glbIdleClip, glbMinScene (3 for meshopt, else null) and material slots. Version 0 is pack FRONT/BACK and requires KHR_texture_transform on both (UV window on a 1024x1536 canvas). Version 1 is the card case (TeamArt/CardBack). Version 2 is the combined opening (FRONT, BACK, TeamArt, CardBack) with a full-bleed 1104x1536 pack-face canvas and no texture transform. Declaring version 0 for a file that satisfies version 2 is rejected. Pack art kinds contain into the version-0 window or the version-2 1104x1536 canvas. Card-case art kinds cover a 1200x1680 canvas. glbTemplateVersion is never defaulted. glbIdleClip is null unless it is CaseIdle on version 2.

glbTemplateVersion.description: kind glb-template: omitted detects the contract. Never defaulted. 0 is pack FRONT/BACK with KHR_texture_transform. 2 is the combined opening and cannot be declared as 0. Pack art kinds: 0 selects the 1024x1536 UV window; 2 selects the full-bleed 1104x1536 canvas.

glbIdleClip.description: kind glb-template only. Null or omitted means idle is off. The only other value is CaseIdle, and only when glbTemplateVersion is 2.

200.description: { path, kind, size, publicUrl, bucket, confirmed, glbTemplateVersion?, glbIdleClip?, glbMinScene?, templateKind?, slots? }

glbTemplateVersion.description: Present for kind glb-template. 0 is FRONT/BACK with KHR_texture_transform (1024x1536 UV window). 2 is the combined opening (full-bleed 1104x1536 pack faces).

glbIdleClip.description: Present for kind glb-template. Null means idle is off. CaseIdle is valid only when glbTemplateVersion is 2.

glbMinScene.description: Present for kind glb-template. 3 means EXT_meshopt_compression; null means no scene-level requirement.

get.summary: Get binder contents grouped by shelf
get.description: Data: { binder, shelves }. Each shelf card adds serial: CardSerial | null — the lowest serial among the owner's copies of that collectible (ties: earliest mint); null when no copy has a recorded serial. Each shelf card adds player: CardPlayer | null at the top level of the card (next to serial): the roster player linked to that collectible; null when none is linked. Each shelf card adds lockedBy and lockedQuantity (BinderLockedCard): the listing/offer lock on the owner's holdings of that collectible in the binder's wallet. lockedQuantity is a reserved copy count capped at the card's quantity, not the inventory reads' 0 = whole row encoding. A PIN-protected binder without a valid token returns metadata only, with no lock data. Binder metadata includes coverStyle (built cover design, or null for classic).

post.description: Charges the caller's D-Sports Cash balance and, in the same transaction, removes or reduces the purchased ShopCartItem lines. Each purchased unit is applied once: the Product id the client sent is cleared first, then another mirror of that pack. A single-item buy of an item that is also in the cart reduces that line. A rejected charge leaves the cart. Optional Idempotency-Key header or idempotencyKey body field (max 128). The same key and the same cart replay the first 200 and do not charge again. The same key with a different cart is 409 IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_CONFLICT. Omitting the key charges every request. Keys are not expired. An omitted pack wallet resolves to the fan's primary wallet (oldest custodial, else oldest of any type), or null when the fan has no wallet (#938).

get.summary: Get published approved copy by slug
get.description: Published, Legal-approved client copy (#998), unauthenticated. `data` is `{ slug, version, updatedAt, blocks: { title, body, bullets } }`. `version` is a publish counter for the served snapshot, not comparable across locale deletion/recreation or English fallback. `updatedAt` is the last publish instant; use locale-keyed ETags for revalidation. Responds 304 with no body when `If-None-Match` matches the served `ETag` (weak, over the whole envelope). `Cache-Control: public, s-maxage=300, stale-while-revalidate=3600` — copy changes rarely. 404 for an unknown or never-published slug (a draft is never served); 400 for a slug that is not lowercase words separated by hyphens. First slug: `rep-explainer` — seeded as an unpublished draft, so it 404s until Legal publishes real wording; clients keep their bundled copy in that window. On a 304 the cached server copy is still current and should be kept; the bundle is only for when no usable cached copy exists. Authored locales (#1044): Accept-Language resolves en/fr-CH/it-IT. Only reviewed published JSON snapshots are served, otherwise English; never machine translation. Every 200/304 sets Vary: Accept-Language and actual Content-Language (en on fallback/empty; en, <requested> on mixed changelog feeds). English bytes/ETags stay legacy; non-English ETags include negotiated locale even on fallback. Cache by negotiated locale. ApprovedCopy version is locale-owned, changelog app version remains base-owned; variant updatedAt is its publish time. Locale deletion/recreation resets its publish counter. Missing new locale table during rollout falls back; unrelated failures return 500.

get.description: Authenticated suggested fans (excludes already-following). Query: cursor, limit.
Public suggested / official teams. Query: limit.
Query: userId (admin impersonation).

Public. Returns Supabase URL, anon key (also as `token`), and the private channel template `events:{gameId}`. Socket auth is Supabase-native: `?apikey=<anonKey>` on the socket URL (native and web) or the `x-api-key` header (native); a user JWT goes in `phx_join.access_token` (prefer `@supabase/supabase-js`, which sends both correctly). Envelope: every `game`/`plays`/`stats` broadcast carries `seq` (= publish-time ms, ordering-only per game+event); stale/duplicate `seq <= lastSeq` is ignored. Broadcasts are full snapshots/replacements, so resync via REST only on (re)join, `phx_error`, or unexpected `phx_close` — never on a jump. Live types score/clock/period/goal/penalty/status are observed by diffing `game` snapshots + `plays` kinds. Resync: snapshot `GET /api/events/{gameId}`, replay `GET /api/events/{gameId}/plays?afterId={lastPlayId}`. Polling/ETag stays the fallback. Only the API service role may broadcast.

200.description: { success, data: { enabled, url, anonKey, token, channelPrefix, channelForGame, private, events, liveTypes, auth, resync, note } }

get.description: Public schedule. Repeatable teamId query param. Used by the locker-room hero strip and the HQ Schedule tab. One teamId with no limits returns that team's full depth (every live/forthcoming game plus every final/past row, up to 150 rows). Multi-team requests default to two separate per-team budgets: an upcoming bucket (live/delayed first, then the next 5 forthcoming kickoffs) and a past bucket (5 slots filled by the most recent completed rows first; a live row older than 6h uses only a leftover slot), merged and deduped by row id under an overall ceiling that scales with team count and the budgets. Games that already happened never take an upcoming slot; rows stuck on a pre-game status past 6h with no live data are served as past games with status and scores untouched. Cancelled fixtures are dropped before selection so they cannot take a slot. Postponed fixtures stay. Game rows explicitly include endedAt: ISO 8601 UTC string | null (#1116). It records the first accepted sync observation of final, not an estimated or vendor-certified finish time. Non-final rows and unknown end times return null. Eligible first observations require a known kickoff not in the future and no more than 12 hours old; existing finals are not backfilled. The stored timestamp is immutable across later and concurrent syncs. A delayed observation can extend the window beyond actual finish. Selected vendor rows are overlaid from stored timestamps in one bounded lookup. A failed lookup preserves schedule progress and known fallback timestamps; unknown timestamps stay null. The first final response can remain null while background persistence completes, plus s-maxage=60 cache latency.

parameters.name: teamId
parameters.description: Repeatable. Fan out per followed/joined team.

parameters.name: upcomingLimit
parameters.description: Optional per-team upcoming-bucket budget. A single teamId with neither limit set returns full depth (up to 150 rows) instead; when only one limit is set, the other defaults to 5. Out-of-range or non-integer values are a 400.

parameters.name: pastLimit
parameters.description: Optional per-team past-bucket budget. A single teamId with neither limit set returns full depth (up to 150 rows) instead; when only one limit is set, the other defaults to 5. Out-of-range or non-integer values are a 400.

get.description: Public cheap live-per-league read for the HQ sport screen. Source is persisted GameEvent rows (status live), never the vendor fan-out; demo fixtures excluded. get.description: Page mode (default): `page` + `hasMore`. Cursor mode (DSE-369): pass opaque `cursor` from a prior `nextCursor`; response includes `nextCursor` (`null` at end). Both modes return `nextCursor` (#689) — a page-1 request has no cursor to send, so page mode is where a client obtains its first one; the only exception is a viewer whose filter was remapped by #614, where a cursor would 400 on the next request and is withheld. Invalid cursor → 400 (decoded against the request filter before any #614 remap). Cursors are scope-keyed (#660): a cursor issued for one `teamId` / `phase` / `postType` / `authorTeamId` / `authorId` / `includeDemo=false` scope 400s when resumed under another scope — always restart from page 1 when the scope changes. Filters: trending|latest|following|foryou. `teamId` narrows to the per-team feed (about-tagged OR authored-as for that team); `authorTeamId` narrows to officially-as-team posts; both compose with `following` as AND. NULL-matches-any: rows with unset `channel` / `teamId` match any `phase` / `teamId` filter, so untagged posts stay in scoped feeds. When the viewer has UserSettings.analyticsPersonalization=false (#614), trending/foryou are served chronological (`latest` order) and a *valid* ranked cursor is dropped after that 400-check. Ranked filters (trending/foryou) additionally carry `rank` (absolute 0-based position, continuing across pages) and `reason` ({ code, label?, subjectId? }) per post, plus `rankVersion` on the envelope (#686) — chronological filters and opted-out viewers carry none of the three. `ads` is `[]` only when inventory is switched off; an opted-out viewer takes the contextual fill path (#687). Feed preferences (#722) are applied for the authenticated viewer on every filter, including when analyticsPersonalization is false: kind `never` excludes matching authors, teams (`teamId` or `authorTeamId`), topics (`channel`), and item types at candidate generation; kind `less` downweights matching posts to one quarter of their reaction count while scoring trending/foryou and does not remove them from chronological feeds. Promoted creatives are not filtered here. Team-news rail (#827): the first page of a team-scoped feed (`teamId` or `authorTeamId` set, no `cursor`, page 1, no `authorId` filter) also carries up to 5 published articles as `data.news` (same fields as GET /api/news items plus `itemType: "news"`). Never present on the global/all feed, later pages, or cursor resumes; omitted (not empty) when there is no news or the news read fails. Each post includes `mentions` (#953): `{ id, handle, name?, profileUrl? }[]`, empty when nobody is tagged. Users the viewer has blocked (either direction) and users with a null handle are omitted.

English bytes/ETags stay legacy; non-English ETags include negotiated locale even on fallback. Cache by negotiated locale. ApprovedCopy version is locale-owned, changelog app version remains base-owned; variant updatedAt is its publish time. Locale deletion/recreation resets its publish counter. Missing new locale table during rollout falls back; unrelated failures return 500.

CardPlayer.description: Roster player linked to a collectible (Collectible.playerId, mint-locked like rarity). name, position and jerseyNumber are read live from the Player row on every read, replays included; teamName is the collectible's team (the card's club).

name.description: Roster name. The card title stays the collectible name.

position.description: Roster position code as stored (F, C, LW, RW, D, G, ...); null when blank.

teamName.description: Name of the collectible's team (the card's club), not the player's current team. Null only when the card has no team row.

winningKey.description: Omitted until the fixture has an authoritative final result.

locked.description: True when authoritative status/start disallows a fresh selection.

awardedBonus.description: Actual credited bonus after void legs are removed; zero before credit.

awardedRep.description: Total additional normal leg Rep credited; excludes the existing engine-session award and bonus.

TeamNameDisplayMode.description: How club names are shown on web and engage-native. full is city plus name (Montreal Canadiens). name_only is the club name (Canadiens). Stored on UserSettings.teamNameDisplayMode. Default full.

CustomizerPreviewMode.description: Pinned customizer preview size for the fan (#931). full is the default size. compact shrinks the preview on scroll. Stored on UserSettings.customizerPreviewMode. Default full.

PackAntialias.description: Pack-opening antialiasing mode for the fan (#923). auto lets the device pick a tier. The server stores the choice and does not know device tiers. Stored on UserSettings.packAntialias. Default auto.

PackQuality.description: Pack-opening quality mode (#854, native W8). The server stores the choice; the device resolves auto. Stored on UserSettings.packQuality. New rows default to auto.

PackSummaryLayout.description: Fan layout for the 3D pack-opening summary (#1155, native#1381). The server stores the choice; native renders it. auto is the device default (today grid). Stored on UserSettings.packSummaryLayout. New rows default to auto.

PackOpenAction.description: Wire value for the Open now / Open later default (#930). open_later is the inert default: the server never opens a pack from this preference. Stored as the PackOpenAction enum OPEN_NOW | OPEN_LATER. Default open_later.

PackOpenChoice.description: Post-checkout Open now / Open later sheet preference (#930), returned on GET and PATCH /api/user/settings. Per account. showSheet defaults true. defaultAction defaults open_later.

newlyCompleted.description: True when this open is what finished the set.

reward.description: Set when this call granted the cosmetic badge. Null otherwise.

missingCollectibleIds.description: Sorted collectible ids the fan does not hold.

completedAt.description: When the cosmetic badge was granted. Null until it is.

redeemable.description: Missing common and rare members, with the point cost.

alreadyRecorded.description: True when this idempotency key replayed a stored receipt.

pointsDelta.description: Positive on trade-in, negative on redeem. Never zero.

ownedAfter.description: Copies of this card the fan holds after the mutation.

reward.description: Set when this call granted the cosmetic badge. Null otherwise.

SeasonState.description: Off-season hub gate (#999). `state` is derived from the league's persisted hockey calendar window (never the gamification points season); `hubEnabled` is the switch native reads instead of a client `SHOW_OFFSEASON_HUB` constant. A manual `stateOverride` or `hubEnabled` on the window wins over the date math.

hubEnabled.description: True when the client should surface the off-season hub. Defaults to `state === "off_season"` unless the window pins it.

data.description: Same as GET /api/user data for the caller.

activeWalletAddress.description: Wallet the pack sections are scoped to: ?walletAddress= when the caller owns it, else the first non-hidden wallet, else the first wallet. Null with no wallets or when wallets failed.

CardTemplate.description: Render template that produced the card image currently being served.

templateKey.description: Required for explicit template selection. Omit when choosing a card front by collectible.

cardFrontCollectibleId.description: Collectible id or team-scoped slug. Selects a v1 card-front template from the collectible's rarity.

sourceHasTransparency.description: Set for transparent player cut-outs to allow Mythic Rays.

expectedTemplateKey.description: Recommended card-front key already shown in the creator.

expectedTemplateVersion.description: Recommended card-front version already shown in the creator.

CreateSubmissionBody.description: Choose an explicit template key (version optional), or a collectible-bound automatic card front. Card-front expectations must be supplied together; they assert the recommendation rather than override it. Template/target compatibility is validated server-side.

slotSpec.description: Template slot specification stored as JSON.

outputSpec.description: Template output specification stored as JSON.

recommendedTemplateId.description: Recommended v1 card-front template for the latest collectible selection, when available.

unavailableTemplateKeys.description: Pack-face keys with no compatible eligible version, when present.

saveUrl.description: Google Wallet Save URL containing the signed JWT.

token.description: Opaque `wgt_` bearer token returned once at issuance.

logo.description: Raster logo URL (`Team.logoPng`, or non-SVG fallback), or null.

color.description: Team.themeColor, falling back to the first nonblank Team.gradientColors entry, or null.

game.description: Best eligible non-demo game: live, soonest upcoming, then latest final; null when none qualifies.

fanRep.description: Earned points plus Fan Rep ledger amounts.

rank.description: Global rank by earned points (not combined Fan Rep), or null when unavailable.

slug.description: Followed club slug for native HQ deep links.

lastPlay.description: Newest play-by-play summary line clamped for widget display.

squadLabel.description: Split-squad label when the club has concurrent squads playing.

deepLink.description: Relative web path under /locker-room/game/ (retained for backward compatibility).

appDeepLink.description: Native app deep link (`engagenative://hq/match/<gameId>`), with `?slug=<slug>` when a club slug is available.

hqLive.description: A live match involving a favorite or followed club, or null if none qualifies.

clubs.description: Present only with `include=clubs`. Up to six favorite or followed clubs, ordered by live games, upcoming games, final games, then clubs without an eligible game.
